entities.name: Efuan Pincar
entities.description: Kingdom on the northern part of Gulmany in the Terisian Isles, with capital Pincar City.

entities.name: Gulmany
entities.description: Great island of the Terisian Isles.

entities.name: Ronom Glacier
entities.description: Glacier whose former site Efuan Pincar occupies.

entities.name: School of the Unseen
entities.description: Sages and wizards who helped found Efuan Pincar.

entities.name: Avohir
entities.description: Worshipped as a deity in Efuan Pincar.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: Praetor who created Phyrexian sleeper agents sent into Efuan Pincar.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Whose machines negated the Phyrexian sleeper threat.

entities.name: Flooding of Terisiare
entities.description: Event during which Efuan Pincar was settled.

events.summary: Efuan Pincar is populated by settlers during the early Flooding of Terisiare, with help from the School of the Unseen.
events.quote: Sages and wizards from the School of the Unseen helped found the new nation

events.summary: Phyrexian sleeper agents created by Gix infiltrate parts of Efuan Pincar but are stopped by Urza's machines.
events.quote: This threat was negated by Urza 's machines.

relations.quote: Efuan Pincar is a kingdom on the great island of Gulmany
